Historically, they were thought to be a type of non-odontogenic cyst that occurred in the region between the maxillary lateral incisor and canine. However, numerous studies have failed to confirm their existence, and many cases previously diagnosed as globulomaxillary cysts have been reclassified as other types of cysts or lesions. As a result, the concept of globulomaxillary cysts is no longer widely accepted in the field of oral pathology.
